name: The Chocolatier
description: A sit-down restaurant in Hershey's Chocolatetown at Hersheypark, where American dishes come with a chocolate twist. It is a relaxing break from the rides, with table service, a family-friendly menu and plenty of desserts that make the most of Hershey's most famous ingredient.

items.name: Chocolate-Glazed Chicken
items.description: Grilled chicken with a light cocoa glaze and seasonal vegetables

items.name: Classic Cheeseburger
items.description: Beef burger with cheese, lettuce, tomato and fries

items.name: Hershey's Chocolate Cake
items.description: Rich layered chocolate cake with whipped cream

items.name: Chocolate Milkshake
items.description: Thick milkshake made with Hershey's chocolate

name: Chef's Market
description: A market-style eatery at Hersheypark where guests choose from several food stations, so everyone in the group can find something they like. It is a good option for families with different tastes, with fresh and hot dishes, salads, sides and desserts.

items.name: Garden Salad
items.description: Fresh greens with seasonal vegetables and dressing

items.name: Pasta of the Day
items.description: Chef's pasta dish with a choice of sauce

name: 1933 Restaurant & Tavern
description: A full-service restaurant and tavern serving American favourites with a selection of beer and cocktails for adults. It is a more relaxed place to sit down, rest your legs and enjoy a proper meal during a long day at the park.

items.name: Pub Burger
items.description: Beef burger with cheddar, bacon and fries

items.name: Crispy Chicken Sandwich
items.description: Fried chicken sandwich with pickles and house sauce

items.name: Pennsylvania Pretzel Appetizer
items.description: Soft pretzel bites with beer cheese
